# Locality Guide: Kentucky / Muhlenberg County (1870–1910)

- **Pre-1911 (county death registers):** Kentucky had no statewide death registration before 1 January 1911. Counties were required to maintain death registers from c.1852, but compliance varied. Muhlenberg County registers survive as FamilySearch digitized images (imageGroup 007991103, 240 images, 1852–1910), but coverage is gappy — especially thin for the 1860s–1870s. Only 4% of images are name-indexed; the rest require browsing image-by-image. Also indexed (partially) in collection 1804888 (Kentucky, Deaths and Burials, 1843-1970, 421,870 records, no images).
- **Post-1911 (statewide certificates):** If Elijah Wilkins survived to 1911 or later, a statewide death certificate would exist. FamilySearch collection 1417491 (Kentucky Deaths, 1911–1967) is indexed with ~2.9 million records and images — the highest-probability starting point if death was in or after 1911.
- **Ancestry:** "Kentucky, U.S., Death Records, 1852–1965" is a separate index of the pre-1911 county registers; worth checking as a fallback.

### Probate records
- FamilySearch collection 1875188 (Kentucky Probate Records, 1727–1990): browse-only images statewide, 1.35 million images total. Muhlenberg County volume (imageGroup 007834412, 1858–1889, 612 images, 0% indexed) has deep 1870s coverage. Estate records — administrator bonds, settlements, inventories — record the decedent's name and implicitly date death via the bond filing date.
- Physical originals at Kentucky Department for Libraries and Archives (KDLA) and Muhlenberg County Court.

### Court order books
- Muhlenberg County Court Order Books 1799–1901 (imageGroup 007834430, 488 images, browse-only): contain administration orders naming decedents and approximate death dates when formal registers are missing.

### Census records
- Federal censuses for Muhlenberg County: 1870 (indexed), 1880 (indexed), 1900 (indexed), 1910 (indexed) — all on FamilySearch. Note: 1890 federal census was almost entirely destroyed by fire; no complete substitute exists.

- FamilySearch collection 1804987 (Kentucky, County Marriages, 1797–1954, ~1.3 million records, indexed + images): useful for confirming family relationships and identifying the FAN cluster.

- Find a Grave (findagrave.com): Muhlenberg County cemeteries browsable online.
